=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Players: the 1 May 2008 news post says 29 players; Richards' bracket had 30 entrants after Matt Lush and William Freeman were added on 16 April (p=291924). The Saturday deck-choice list (p=296728) has 29 names and lacks Scott Church (seed 19), so one entrant may not have played. The page keeps 29.
* Spellings differ between the seeding and deck lists: Bobby Hilbun / Hilburn (wiki page [[Bobby Hilburn]]), Chris Schoenthal / Shoenthal, Stephen / Steven Wilcox, and Christopher Perry (seed 26) / Matthew Perry (deck list; Richards called Freeman a friend of "Matthew Perry"). The Perry entries are left unlinked.
=== Left out ===
* The "top 8 was 2 Profit, 2 Hunt Down, 2 WYS and 2 anti-Senate decks" claim from the gap list: the cited post (p=296865) says only that both finalists' Dark decks looked like anti-Senate decks.
* The projected payouts in the first post ($550/$250/$100) and the 31 March projection ($233.75/$106.25/$42.50): projections, not the actual payout.
* Store phone number.
=== Missing data ===
* Full bracket results (the bracketmaker.com bracket was not checked), places 5 and lower, and the side-event standings.

== Day 2 decklists published, 24 November 2026 ==
The eight printouts of [[:File:2008 Texas Match Play Championship Day 2.pdf]] are now deck pages, linked under [[2008 Texas Match Play Championship#Day 2 decklists|Day 2 decklists]] and in the four players' Tournament Results rows. The PDF on res.starwarsccg.org has the same bytes (SHA-1 2c7d45e5…) as the wiki file; its Internet Archive capture of 14 October 2026 was checked (served gzip-encoded; the decompressed bytes have the same SHA-256).
=== How the sheets were attributed ===
* The Player Name, Event and Date boxes are blank on all eight sheets. The browser footer gives the file names <code>gregds_day2.html</code>, <code>gregls_day2.html</code>, <code>joeds_day2.html</code>, <code>joels_day2.html</code>, <code>kevinds_day2.html</code>, <code>kevinls_day2.html</code>, <code>scottds_day2.html</code> and <code>scottls_day2.html</code>, and the print date 4/29/2008.
* Day 2 was the final four (Richards' schedule, p=270787); the final four were Shannon, Lingrell, Olson and Shaw (news sid=85). Each first name matches exactly one of them.
* Kevin and Scott: the sheets are BHBM / WYS and CCT (podracing) / Profit, the decks posted for Shannon and Lingrell on Saturday (p=296728) and named for the final (p=296865). Attributed without a flag.
* Greg: My Lord, Is That Legal? / Plead My Case To The Senate. Compared with [[2008 Match Play Championship Day 1 Greg Shaw DS My Lord, Is That Legal?]]: 70 of 72 cards the same (sheet adds SFS L-s9.3 Laser Cannons and Tatooine; the January list has Crossfire (V) and Maul's Sith Infiltrator). Compared with [[2008 Match Play Championship Day 1 Greg Shaw LS Plead My Case To The Senate]]: 60 of 72 the same; most of the differences are Virtual Set 15 cards (Anger, Fear, Aggression (V), Booster In Pulsar Skate (V), IL-19 (V)), which were legal at Texas but not in January. So the Greg sheets look like Shaw's own decks, updated for Virtual Set 15. Against that, p=296728 gives Shaw Profit and Hunt Down, and Clarkson (p=296815) wrote that neither Light Side Senate player made the top four. Flagged.
* Joe: Bring Him Before Me / Hidden Base. The Dark sheet differs from the Kevin Dark sheet by three cards (Joe has Cold Feet (V), Limited Resources and a second Young Fool; Kevin has Evader & Monnok, Maul's Sith Infiltrator and Security Precautions) and three shields. Compared against all 339 live 2008 deck pages, the closest Light list shares only 47 of 72 cards (Eric Goodnough's 2008 New York State Championship Hidden Base). Olson's posted Saturday decks were WYS and Hunt Down; his 2008 Match Play Championship and 2008 Worlds decks are other objectives. Flagged.
* The PDF has no Hunt Down deck, though the Saturday post gives Hunt Down to both Shaw and Olson.
* Entry on [[Mysteries#2008 Texas Match Play Championship Day 2 sheets|Mysteries]].
=== Card links ===
* The sheets mark original Virtual cards with their set, for example "(V15)"; each links to the original-Virtual-Set page of that set. Two have no original-set page on the wiki and link the current (V) page: Yoda, Master Of The Force (V14) → [[Yoda, Master Of The Force (V)]] and Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (V15) → [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (V)]].
* "Tatooine (EP1)" is the Episode I Tatooine system from [[Coruscant (expansion)|Coruscant]]: [[Tatooine (Dark) (Coruscant)]] and [[Tatooine (Light) (Coruscant)]].
* Each sheet's Defensive Shields column holds 12 cards and is transcribed as printed. Several are not Defensive Shields on their card pages: Aquaris, Endor, Kessel and Kiffex (Joe Light), Han's Toolkit (V) and Landing Claw (Kevin Light), Mandalorian Armor, Restraining Bolt, Restricted Access (V) and There'll Be Hell To Pay (Scott Dark), What're You Tryin' To Push On Us? (Greg and Scott Light), and The Professor (V) (Greg, Kevin and Scott Light). Why they were listed there is not known.
